answer: An agent marketplace weights votes by escrowed stake, so splitting 100 tokens among agents named nebula, mirror, and zephyr gives the same total voting power as one agent holding 100 tokens. The contract locks each deposit for 30 days, including after a vote, preventing reuse across identities during that period. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens; generating extra identities adds no voting power.
